item.description:
This is my first "capper" Thread

Broadcast Date: Wednesday, January 7, 2026

Guests:




    • Chelsea Handler: The comedian joined Jimmy to look back on her role hosting the Critics Choice Awards. She also participated in a segment called "Black Diamond Confessions" and shared a wild story about going on a psychedelic cruise with a man she met while gambling in Las Vegas.
    • Sophie Turner: The actress discussed her role in the new crime thriller series Steal and talked about taking on the iconic role of Lara Croft. She also reflected on the 15-year legacy of Game of Thrones.
    • Hudson Williams: The star of the hit series Heated Rivalry made his late-night debut.
      • Highlights: He taught Jimmy a hockey stretch, discussed "intimacy garments" and "boy aquariums," and performed a sketch where he had to break up a "Heated Rivalry" style fight between Jimmy and Tariq.
Musical Guest:




    • Sienna Spiro: She performed her song "Die On This Hill."
